evidence.uncertainty: The current application has anonymous per-document capabilities only; JWT signing, safe bootstrap login, user identity propagation, and ownership-preserving errors must be introduced without exposing secrets or weakening the local demo.
evidence.scope: This spans settings, API contracts, application composition, document ownership, frontend session state, environment examples, and backend/frontend tests.
evidence.reasoning: The work creates an authentication and authorisation boundary involving password verification, signature validation, expiry, algorithm restrictions, token claims, CORS, browser memory, and indistinguishable missing-versus-foreign document behaviour.
evidence.verification: Focused authentication and ownership tests are required alongside existing lifecycle tests, strict backend checks, and browser-facing frontend checks. Live credentials must not be used.
